html:
Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Tech from beyond this millennium has hit MARVEL Future Fight! 
Enjoy the fresh new looks of this <Armor War 3099> themed Update.

 

In this update, there will be new uniforms for 
Doctor Doom, Rescue, and Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44).
 

Tier-3 Advancement for Doctor Doom and 
Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential for 
Rescue and Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44).
 

Agents! We also prepared <Summer Days> Uniforms 
for Quicksilver and Silk for you to enjoy this Summer!
 

Also, various improvements have been made for your convenience, such as
the addition of ISO-8 Set: Auto Set Change function, Menu UI changes, and Next Reward button after tapping the Acquire button in Dispatch Mission.
 

Prepare for battles to come by checking out the details below. 

 

 

 

▣ 5 New Uniforms

 

Doctor Doom, Rescue, and Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44) acquired new <Armor War 3099> uniforms and Quicksilver and Silk acquired new <Summer Days> uniforms!
Have a blast this Summer with their upgraded gear!
 

[<3099> Uniforms Notice]
* New Uniform Skills are based on Skill Level 6 stats.
* Doctor Doom, Rescue, Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44) Uniforms will be on a 40% off sale during the upcoming <2021 Summer Festival Special Event!> and will be available for purchase in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the event.
- War Machine <3099> Uniform will be displayed in-game after the August Update, but will not be available for purchase. Purchase will be available after a patch which will be announced later.


[Summer Days Uniform Notice ]
* New Uniform Skills are based on Skill Level 6 stats.
* Silk <Summer Days> can be acquired with tokens at the ‘Silk’s Ice-cream Token Shop’.
   Methods of acquiring the tokens will be announced later.
* Quicksilver <Summer Days> can be purchased with crystals and will not be on sale. 
* Quicksilver and Silk <Summer Days> Uniforms will only be available for purchase during the event.
 - This event, packages, items may return in the future.

 

   

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ 5 New Potential Realized Characters
 
A total of 5 characters, Adam Warlock, Mantis, Singularity, Ultron, and Yondu will realize their Potential through the August Update. 
These heroes can now be upgraded to Level 70. 

 

 

 

▣ Doctor Doom Tier-3 Ultimate Skill

 

Doctor Doom, the Super Villain that has mastered both science and magic, 

can now Advance to Tier-3. 


All will bow before him. 


The supreme leader of Latveria will continue his rule with even greater power. 
Check out his new Ultimate Skill!
 

 

 

 

 

▣ Rescue and Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44) Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential

 

Through this Update, Rescue and Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44) 

will be able to Awaken and Transcend their Potentials. 

 

Check out the new suits packed with top of the line gears. 

 

 

 

▣ C.T.P. of Authority 

Changes have been made to the C.T.P. of Authority.
Check out the details below and use the C.T.P. of Authority to the fullest! 

 

[New effect ‘Steel’]
1. Fills gauge upon being hit.
2. When the gauge hits 100%, the effects will be applied automatically. 
Effects are Guard Break and Super Guard Break Immunity and decreases damage taken.
3. Cannot fill the gauge for a certain amount of time after the effects have been applied to a character. 

* The table above shows the highest achievable stats for C.T.P. of Authority. 

 

 

 

▣ ISO-8 Set Convenience Improvements

 

An Auto Set Change function has been added! Roll until you acquire the desired ISO-8 set!

 

 

 

▣ Menu UI

 

Improvements have been made to the Menu. 
We have newly arranged the Menu and added some categories so that Agents can access nearly everything from the Menu!

 

 

 

▣ Dispatch Mission: Next Reward 

 

An improvement has been made to the Dispatch Mission: ‘Acquire’ button.
Agents can now acquire rewards in succession by tapping the ‘Next Reward’ button after tapping an ‘Acquire’ button from any sector.
 

 

 

 

▣ New Season of Future Pass & New Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the Update.
Various rewards and Special Icons can be obtained through the Future Pass!

 

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

 

- The Future Pass effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Pass will only be available during the season the pass was purchased, so please do not forget to check the remaining event time!
- The Mythic Pass can only be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- The Legendary and Mythic Future Pass will not be available for purchase near the end of a season, so please check the in-game sale schedule.

 

Also, there are Special Icons that can represent our Agents!
Collect two new icons as Future Pass Rewards and one more from the upcoming Event!
 

 

[New Special Icons]

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection
 
Check out the new uniforms of the August Update.
There are rewards for completing the collection, so be sure to claim them!

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements

 

1. Legendary Battle Bonus Reward pop-up screen has been improved so that Agents can directly access missions. 

 

2. Agents can now check how much of each material they own on the Select difficulty screen in World Boss.  

 

3. Reset Today’s World Boss tab will also be displayed to Agents below VIP Level 2.
- For Agents below VIP Level 2, the tab will display information on the VIP system instead of being able to Reset Today’s World Boss.

 

4. Mockery and Steel have been added to the Skill Name Glossary. 


5. The name of the token that was rewarded in Dimension Mission will be changed to ‘Support Token’ from ‘Rift Token’.

 

6. The names, ‘Item Shop’ and ‘Dimension Token’ in Dispatch Mission will be changed to ‘Dispatch Shop’ and ‘Dispatch Token’.

 

 

 

▣ Error Fixes
 

1. The issue of Awakened Skill of Supergiant being displayed as if it is also unlocked when upgrading her to ★6 has been fixed.


 2. The issue of when ‘Guide Quest reward: Titan’s Record’ has been distributed while a character is wearing a uniform that changes their type, the Titan’s Record displays the ‘changed character type’ instead of the character’s original type has been fixed.


3. The issue of Agents who were not under the effect of S.H.I.E.L.D. Special Support, experiencing as if the trial product [Inventory Slot Increase] was not being applied when they have logged-in for the first time has been fixed.


​4. The issue of an additional information pop-up appearing on the ‘Select Characters > Set Ally Team’ screen even after finishing the World Boss: Legend - Tutorial has been fixed.


​5. The issue of pop-up alarms constantly being displayed 
even after acquiring the daily reward for the Monthly Bonus Deals has been fixed. 


​6. The issue of ‘A.I. On’ button being activated upon entering Preview Skill in the Battle Guide has been fixed.


​7. The issue of Agent Tokens not being distributed as a reward for World Event - Battle Grade has been fixed.

[8/4 1:00 a.m. /  8/3 6:00 p.m. added]

- An appropriate amount of Agent Tokens have been sent to the Inbox of Agents who participated in the World event at ‘7/10 11:00 p.m. (UTC+0), 7/10 4:00 p.m. (PDT)’ 
and failed to receive rewards for the World Event - Battle Grade.


8. The issue of ‘Leadership’ Ability effect icon not being displayed on World Boss Challenge has been fixed.


9 . The issue of Taskmaster’s Tier-2 skill not being displayed correctly in certain situations has been fixed. 


10. The issue of the Close button moving to the side when tapping on it on the Free Hero Chest result screen has been fixed. 


11. The issue of the ‘Silence’ effect icon not being displayed correctly on IOS devices has been fixed.


12. The issue of ‘Increase damage to Super Villain faction’ effect icons being displayed as ‘1 sec.’ left when using the Tier-3 skill of Captain America (Sam Wilson) <Marvel Studios’ The Falcon and the Winter Soldier> Uniform has been fixed.


13. The issue of Black Widow’s uniforms <Marvel Studios’ Black Widow> and <Marvel Studios’ Black Widow (Snow Suit)> active skill #5 (Black Widow Back Up Fire) effect being blocked from view by structures when playing phase 1 of World Boss: Knull has been fixed.


14. The issue of not being able to sell certain event tokens has been fixed.


15. The issue of World Boss: Thanos Level 60 unlock requirements being unclear has been fixed, from Nova to Nova (Sam Alexander).


16. The issue of Alliance Battle Extreme ‘Recommended’ system going slightly off the intended 28 day rotation has been fixed.


17. The issue of certain Potential Awakened or Realized characters not being able to fill their skill gauge when using active skills in Danger Room has been fixed.


18. The issue of penalties not being applied under certain conditions when reusing characters in Danger Room: Extreme has been fixed.


19. The issue of Danger Room: Extreme Boss <Stryfe> occasionally not coming down after jumping up in the air has been fixed.


20. The issue of when all of the enemies die between Mr. Fantastic <The Maker> Uniform Active 1 Skill Expanded Hammer Fist’s first and second punch, the last smash not being activated has been fixed.

 


﻿We will return with more contents and improvements in the next update.
 

Thank you.
